'''Cibinel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where he and his convoy were ambushed by enemy forces in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="Supply Lines">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Supply Lines|Tatooine}}</ref>
